title: Texting After a Date
aliases: date er por kokhon text korbo
summary: If you enjoyed the date, a simple message the same evening or next day ('Had a great time, would love to do it again') is clear and kind. Games about waiting are unnecessary.
answer_guidance: Keep it light, practical and encouraging. Define slang plainly and give realistic tips; avoid gender stereotypes.
